definitions.explanation: A person whose behavior or appearance arouses suspicion. Commonly used in safety announcements and crime reports.

examples.japanese: {不審者|ふしんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧。
⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{不審者|ふしんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目撃|もくげき}→目撃：13627_mokugeki⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A suspicious person was spotted near the school.

examples.japanese: {不審者|ふしんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}かけたら→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通報|つうほう}→通報：14318_tsuuhou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If you see a suspicious person, please call the police immediately.

notes:
USAGE:
Frequently used in community safety bulletins, school circulars, and police announcements. Japanese neighborhoods often have signs reading {不審者|ふしんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧ (beware of suspicious persons).

FORMS:
⟦{不審|ふしん}→不審：16934_fushin⟧ (suspicious, doubtful) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不審者|ふしんしゃ}⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧: suspicious person report
- {不審者|ふしんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通報|つうほう}→通報：14318_tsuuhou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to report a suspicious person
- {不審者|ふしんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけられる→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to be approached by a suspicious person
